question.text: Algo providers offering Black box algorithms (non-transparent) must:

answer.text: Register as a Research Analyst, maintain a research report for each algo, and register each logic change as a new algo with exchange confirmation
Simply notify the exchange after deployment
Only register with SEBI, not the exchange
No registration is needed for any algo type

explanation.text: The Logic: Black box algo providers must register as Research Analysts and maintain a research report for each algorithm. Each logic change must be registered as a new algo, with confirmation to the exchange that the research report has been maintained. The Trap: Post-deployment notification is not enough, and SEBI-only registration is insufficient — the exchange must also be informed. Registration is mandatory; it is not waived for any algo type. Note: White box (execution algos such as TWAP/VWAP) are not treated as new algos under the same regime.
